column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   base  <ref>  <sha>  <engine version there>
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
# A base of - means no red run was possible. Reproduce with: tests/red <ref>
base
run
a # in a later cell, UTF-8 text, trailing spaces, a blank line and an optional column left off are accepted
a CR is refused, and only exceptions.sh strips it from the last cell
a NUL is refused, and grep reads the whole table as binary
a checkout with tables and no schemas.tsv cannot look either, exit 2
a code point past U+10FFFF is refused as not UTF-8, which the platform's iconv lets through
a column marked optional is not a glob: a seven-cell stack row is refused beside files it would match
a decline whose reason holds a tab, a newline and a CR is one row
a file that ends in a NUL is refused for its last byte as well as for the NUL
a file whose row says it lives in memory fails when it is in the tree
a line of spaces is refused, and the raw case loops take it for a row
a line that begins with a non-ASCII byte is refused, since whether it is a comment depends on the locale
a missing final newline is refused, and the done-< loops drop that row
a one-column table of one-cell rows is accepted
a probes table with comments and no row is refused, since its row says emptiness is
a row wider than the schema is refused
a row with no tab is refused
a schema row of five cells, and columns with a doubled space, are malformed on their own terms
a schema row with a bad place, a bad emptiness, a path, a required column after an optional one, a bad name or a duplicate is malformed
a schema row with a place that is neither tree nor memory fails
a schemas.tsv it cannot read is cannot-examine, exit 2, not every table undeclared
a tab-indented comment is refused, and the raw case loops take it for a row
a table added today with no schema row fails, where a list of known tables saw nothing
a table created and never added is checked too, and fails with no row
a table emptied whose row refuses emptiness fails
a table not named .tsv, declared by its basename, is read and here refused for a third cell
a table that is a link fails
a table that is a link is refused: the escape check compares the link's text and a reader reads its target
a table under a directory named like an awk assignment is read, and refused
a table whose last row lost its newline fails
a tracked table missing from the working tree fails
a tree row no table matches is not a failure: some tables are absent until written
a tree whose every table is declared and accepted exits 0
an absent file cannot be examined, exit 2
an empty cell is refused, and an IFS read moves every later column
an indented comment is refused, and the read-and-case loops take it for a row
and a tab in one of its rows is a refused second cell
and a table whose name git quotes is one no reader opens by that name
and a table with no schema row cannot be examined either: undeclared is not clean
and accepted once its rows fit
and every one has a schema row and is accepted
and felix's qualification table declares every control for the schema checker
and from a nested subdirectory the verdict is unchanged
and it is said

and names the file

and one under a directory named like an option keeps its final-newline check
and says how many tables it read
and says it is empty
and says so
and says so as emptiness
and so is a zero-byte one
and so is one whose rows may stop after one cell, while a true one-column table is not
and with both gone the tree is clean again
